diagnosis: Check C5, which is intended to depend on the hidden fact PF3 (family transportation confirmation), passed in every single rollout despite the decision-maker never having access to PF3. The model consistently outputs a departure time of '4:00 p.m.' in the decisions and commitments, likely because this value was already present in the shared public facts (S3) or is being treated as a default/safe value for work-based learning scenarios.

C5.why: The family transportation confirmation changes the attendance days from Tuesday and Thursday to Monday and Wednesday and sets the required departure time at 4:00 p.m.
